shortDescription: SSC Delhi Police Constable Executive PE & MT Admit Card 2026 is available for download. The physical exam is scheduled to start from 18 September 2026.
content:
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Delhi Police Constable Executive Recruitment 2025 PE & MT Admit Card for eligible candidates. The physical test is scheduled to begin from 18 September 2026.

Qualified candidates can download the call letter from the official SSC/Delhi Police portal and check their exam centre, reporting time and document requirements before appearing for the PE & MT round.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 22/09/2025
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 31/10/2025
  • Last Date Pay Exam Fee: 31/10/2025
  • Self Slot Booking: 05 to 10 December 2025
  • Exam Date 2025: 18 December 2025 to 06 January 2026
  • Answer Key Available: 13/01/2026
  • Result Available: 19/06/2026
  • Final Answer Key: 07/07/2026
  • PE & MT Exam Start: 18/09/2026
  • Admit Card Available: 10/09/2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: ₹100
  • SC / ST: ₹0
  • All Female Candidates: ₹0

Examination fees were to be paid online through debit card, credit card, net banking or challan as per the instructions on the SSC portal.

Age Limit

  • Minimum age: 18 years
  • Maximum age: 25 years
  • Age relaxation: As per SSC / Delhi Police recruitment rules

Vacancy Details

Total: 7565 Posts

Post Name: Delhi Police Constable (Executive)

Eligibility: 10+2 Intermediate passed from a recognized board. Physical standards and PET details are mandatory and must be met by all shortlisted candidates.

Physical Standards

Male PET Details

  • Height: 170 cm
  • 1600 meter: 6 minutes
  • Long Jump: 14 feet
  • High Jump: 3’9"

Female PET Details

  • Height: 157 cm
  • 1600 meter: 8 minutes
  • Long Jump: 10 feet
  • High Jump: 3 feet

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official SSC portal or the direct PE & MT admit card link.
  2. Open the Delhi Police Constable Executive admit card page.
  3. Login using your Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  4. Download the hall ticket and check all details carefully.
  5. Print the admit card and carry it to the PE & MT venue with a valid photo ID.

Applicants are advised to read the full official notification before reporting for the physical test and to keep all required documents ready.
